_about: Public-domain David Swing (1830-1894), Presbyterian and then independent preacher of Central Music Hall, Chicago, for the Word Hoard: Truths for To-day (two series, 1874 and 1876), David Swing's Sermons (1874), Motives of Life (1879), his Sermons (1884), Echoes from Central Music Hall (1894), Old Pictures of Life (1894), the memorial volume of ten sermons he chose himself (1894), Truths Leaf by Leaf (1905) and The Message of David Swing to his Generation (1913). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 77 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

swing-truths-for-today: Truths for to-day, spoken in the past winter (Chicago, Jansen, McClurg and company, 1874)
swing-truths-second-series: Truths for to-day : Second series (Chicago : Jansen, McClurg and company, 1876)

swing-old-pictures-of-life: Old pictures of life, vol. 1 (Chicago, Stone and Kimball, 1894)

_excluded.swing-other: Club Essays (literary essays); the record of his heresy trial, Patton vs. Swing (both sides, many hands)
